notes: Sources: open.data.gov.mt and data.gov.mt are the national open data portal and its documented alternate host (data/catalogue/portal_seeds.json). mita.gov.mt is the operating agency (Malta Information Technology Agency) per the same seed entry. nso.gov.mt is the National Statistics Office. legislation.mt is the Laws of Malta corpus; justiceservices.gov.mt is the wider Ministry for Justice services hub. economy.gov.mt is the Ministry for the Economy (Impact-dimension). parlament.mt is Parliament. gov.mt is the government root. data.europa.eu is deliberately excluded per D22. Authored for EXP-23; sanity-check before promoting to production retrieval narrowing. The list is 10 entries; Serper's SRCH-8 cap keeps the first 8 (everything down to justiceservices.gov.mt), so economy.gov.mt and parlament.mt are reserve.
